item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric and reconstruct the Urdu script from its Roman transcription.

item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "درشن کا اجالا لے کے چلے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Salam"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Darshan ka ujala ley keh chaley, ankhon main andhera chor gaye
Akbar ko kahan ki jaldi thi, baba ko akeyla chor gaye

1
Asghar ko thi ran ki dhun mein kahan, maata ke dharaktey dil ki khabar
Nannhey se sipahi khaemey mein, tehra hua jhoola chor gaye

2
Abbas ne dariya chheen ke bhi, bachchon hi ki khatir mashk bhari
Pyase they magar pyase hi phirey, dariya ko chalakta chor gaye

3
Qaedi to buhut se dekhey hain, poochey koi un ke jee se magar
Jo goad ke paaley bachon ko, maidaan mein sota chor gaye

4
Sar kaat ke Koofey walo ney, ye aur naya aphraad kiya
Maidaan ki jalti raeti per, Shabbir ka lasha chor gaye

item.text:
Reconstructed all 10 Urdu verses in [drshn-ka-ajala-le-ke-chale.md](src/data/lyrics/drshn-ka-ajala-le-ke-chale.md), preserving the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have the same opening and four numbered stanzas. Set the direction to `rtl` and removed `noUrdu`.

In stanza 4, I read the ambiguous Roman `aphraad` as `اپرادھ` (“offense”).
